title: Successor reconstruction from signed index
statement: For every integer $e$, let its sign bit indicate whether it is negative and let its unsigned index be $-e-1$ when it is negative and $e$ otherwise. Recovering an integer by negating the index when it is negative, and using the index plus one otherwise, gives $e+1$.
